description: Rail Crossings is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Main Roads Western Australia. Freight or passenger rail network in Western Australia. Rail transport is a means of conveyance of passengers & goods by way of wheeled vehicles running on rail tracks. Coverage: Main Roads Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Main Roads Western Australia. Its tags are Road Assets, open data. It offers 8 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
